newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hamas rejects Israel-PLO deal on Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Hamas rejects Israel-PLO deal on Hebron.

text.p: The Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas said on Wednesday it rejected a Palestinian-Israeli deal extending Palestinian rule to the West Bank town of Hebron and warned self-rule authorities against cracking down on militants.

"Hamas rejects this pact which is an extension to the Oslo accord," the group, which opposes the 1993 Palestinian-Israeli peace agreement, said in a statement sent to an international news agency in Beirut.
Under the pact concluded early on Wednesday Israel will hand over most of Hebron to Palestinian rule within 10 days.
In its statement, Hamas warned the Palestinian self-rule authorities against chasing militants under what it said were pledges made by President Yasser Arafat under the deal.

"It (Hamas) warns the Palestinian authority against launching an arrest campaign against the movement...especially in the area of Hebron and against hitting the group's infrastructure in accordance with pledges made under the deal," the statement said.
Negotiators initialled the accord on the border between Israel and the Gaza Strip at an overnight meeting between Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
